_about: Film style (studio/story/film.py): one painted 3D-film shot per beat, the cast kept consistent with reference portraits; 'clip' shots get ~1.4 s of AI motion, the rest a depth-parallax camera move. 'at' = the word that starts the shot (word#n, counted case-insensitively).

cast.hero: a 29 year old doctor with black slicked hair, a black mustache and a long dark green coat with gold buttons
cast.mother: a young mother with brown hair in a bun and a long dark red 19th century dress
cast.friend: a kind 43 year old professor with grey hair, grey sideburns and small round glasses in a brown coat
cast.elder: a stern old professor with white hair and white whiskers in a black frock coat
cast.pasteur: an old French scientist with a short grey beard and a black velvet cap

shots.name: hook
shots.prompt: close-up, {hero} pointing firmly at a white washbasin, stern face, in a long 1847 hospital ward with iron beds, candle light
shots.motion: he points firmly and frowns, candle flames flicker, slow camera push in

shots.name: bleach
shots.prompt: extreme close-up of a man's hands scrubbing hard in a porcelain basin of cloudy white water with foam, green coat sleeves, candle light
shots.motion: the hands scrub and rub together in the foamy water, slow camera push in

shots.name: mother
shots.prompt: {mother} lying in an iron hospital bed looking up worried, white pillow, 1847 maternity ward, soft window light
shots.motion: she looks up worried and breathes, slow camera push in

shots.name: offended
shots.prompt: medium shot, {elder} and two other old doctors in black coats with arms crossed, offended and frowning, a grand 1847 lecture hall with wooden benches, warm lamp light
shots.motion: they frown and shake their heads, slow camera push in

shots.name: gentlemen
shots.prompt: low angle, proud elegant old doctors in top hats and fine black coats lifting their chins, standing in front of a grand Vienna hospital, golden afternoon light

shots.name: dirty
shots.prompt: extreme close-up of a doctor's pale hands with dark dried stains under the fingernails, black coat cuffs, dark background, candle light
shots.motion: the hands turn over slowly, candle light flickers, slow camera push in

shots.name: clinic
shots.prompt: wide shot of a long gloomy 1847 maternity ward with two rows of iron beds, women lying sick, tall arched windows, grey dusk light, dust in the air

shots.name: dying
shots.prompt: close-up, a pale sick sweating woman lying in a hospital bed with eyes half closed, she is {mother}, gloomy ward, cold dusk light
shots.motion: she breathes weakly and closes her eyes, slow camera push in

shots.name: three
shots.prompt: two hospital doors side by side in a stone corridor, the left door dark and grim with black cloth, the right door warm and glowing with candle light, 1847

shots.name: begging
shots.prompt: full body, {mother} on her knees on stone steps begging with clasped hands raised, in front of a grand old hospital gate at dusk, warm lamps, low angle
shots.motion: her clasped hands shake as she pleads, lamps flicker, slow camera push in

shots.name: street
shots.prompt: {mother} sitting on a cobblestone street at night holding a newborn baby wrapped in a shawl, a street lantern, old Vienna houses
shots.motion: she rocks the baby gently, the lantern flickers, slow camera push in

shots.name: friend
shots.prompt: medium shot, {friend} smiling and teaching young students in an 1847 anatomy room, wooden tables, oil lamps

shots.name: scalpel
shots.prompt: extreme close-up of a scalpel blade slipping and nicking a man's finger, a small drop of red blood, brown coat sleeve, anatomy table, lamp light
shots.motion: the blade slips and a drop of blood forms, slow camera push in

shots.name: signs
shots.prompt: {friend} lying very sick and pale in a hospital bed, sweating, fever, dim night ward, a candle
shots.motion: he breathes weakly and his head turns, the candle flickers, slow camera push in

shots.name: chicken
shots.prompt: close-up of hands cutting a raw chicken on a wooden board in a cozy kitchen, a knife, warm window light
shots.motion: the knife cuts into the raw chicken, slow camera push in

shots.name: salad
shots.prompt: close-up of the same unwashed hands tearing fresh green salad leaves into a bowl next to a raw chicken on a wooden board, cozy kitchen, warm window light
shots.motion: the hands tear the salad leaves into the bowl, slow camera push in

shots.name: morning
shots.prompt: a dim stone autopsy room at dawn, doctors in dark coats standing around a stone table with a body under a white sheet, cold blue light through a high window

shots.name: living
shots.prompt: medium shot, {hero} walking quickly through a doorway into a bright maternity ward, rolling down his sleeves, mothers in beds
shots.motion: he walks forward through the doorway, slow camera move back

shots.name: midwives
shots.prompt: a kind midwife with a white bonnet and white apron gently holding a newborn baby next to a smiling mother in a clean bright ward, warm sunlight
shots.motion: the midwife rocks the baby gently, the mother smiles, slow camera push in

shots.name: order
shots.prompt: medium shot, {hero} nailing a handwritten notice to a wooden ward door while young students line up behind him, morning light

shots.name: lime
shots.prompt: close-up of hands dipping into a porcelain basin of milky white chlorinated lime water, a wooden ward, morning light
shots.motion: the hands dip and wash in the milky water, slow camera push in

shots.name: fell
shots.prompt: {mother} sitting up in a hospital bed, smiling and holding her healthy baby, a bright sunny ward with flowers
shots.motion: she smiles and rocks the baby, sunlight shimmers, slow camera push in

shots.name: rejected
shots.prompt: medium shot, {elder} and other old doctors in black coats laughing and pointing mockingly, a grand 1847 lecture hall, warm lamp light
shots.motion: they laugh and point, slow camera push in

shots.name: asylum
shots.prompt: a grim grey stone asylum building with barred windows on a rainy night, iron gate, a single lamp

shots.name: guards
shots.prompt: {hero} struggling between two rough guards in grey uniforms in a dark stone corridor, a lantern
shots.motion: the guards drag him down the corridor, the lantern swings, slow camera push in

shots.name: died
shots.prompt: high angle, {hero} lying sick and pale in an iron bed with a bandaged hand, a bare stone asylum cell at night, moonlight through a barred window
shots.motion: he breathes weakly and closes his eyes, slow camera push in

shots.name: pasteur
shots.prompt: {pasteur} looking into a brass microscope in a 19th century laboratory full of glass flasks, warm lamp light

shots.name: vindicated
shots.prompt: an old oil portrait painting of {hero} in a gold frame hanging on a museum wall, warm spotlight

shots.name: twist
shots.prompt: close-up, {hero} looking sadly at his own bandaged hand, standing beside a white washbasin, dusk light through a ward window
shots.motion: he slowly lifts his bandaged hand and looks at it, slow camera push in

shots.name: end
shots.prompt: extreme close-up of a bandaged hand with a dark red stain resting on the edge of a white porcelain washbasin, dusk light, dark background
shots.motion: the bandaged hand trembles slightly, the light fades, very slow camera push in
